messages:
lee wong: FYI launching model-router v2 to canary now. feature flag `router.v2` will start at 1% with an ops hold at 25%.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued (db-7930). Canary replicas: 3. healthchecks enabled.

emily rogers: ramp plan: 1% -> 5% @10m -> 15% @25m -> hold @25% for approval -> 50% @90m -> 100% after 3h stable. rollback if error_rate >0.5% or p95 delta >120ms.

tarun das: note: expect KV warmup causing p95 blips for ~3-5m after each step. add a 4m grace window for p95. I'll prep pin script for fast fallback.

ops-bot: Reminder: manual holdpoint configured at 25%. Oncall will be paged.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 1%. Healthchecks passing 3/3.

emily rogers: 5% at +11m: p95 +20ms, errors steady. moving to 15%.

tarun das: merged small config that pins rollback target `model-router-v1` with ttl=1800s. snippet in deploy config.

deploy-bot: Reached 25% holdpoint. Oncall paging for approval.

emily rogers: oncall approved to continue. metrics within thresholds, ignoring sub-4m warmup spikes.

lee wong: continue to 50%. keep auto-rollback armed. if we see oscillation between 15-50%, throttle and re-evaluate.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% scheduled after soak.

emily rogers: final: 100% live, no rollback. release notes updated: "model-router v2 rolled out via staged feature flag ramp; warmup guidance; rollback pin configured."

lee wong: thanks all 389. I'll open a retro item to tune the grace window and thresholds.
